t: A revival of the ancient Pandya dynasty of Madurai that overturned Chola rule and became the leading power of south India c. 1250–1310.
Its ports, above all Kayal, grew rich on pearls and on importing thousands of horses each year from Arabia and the Persian Gulf.
A succession war and the Delhi Sultanate’s invasions from 1311 destroyed it, and Madurai became a sultanate in 1335.
dyk: Marco Polo wrote that the horses imported into the Pandya country died quickly in the south Indian climate, so the kings had to buy thousands more each year.
ev: The Chola king Kulottunga III sacks Madurai
Maravarman Sundara Pandya I burns Thanjavur and Uraiyur
Jatavarman Sundara Pandya I defeats and kills the Hoysala Vira Someshvara
Maravarman Kulasekara I defeats Rajendra III, the last Chola king
Pandya forces take the Tooth Relic from Yapahuwa in Sri Lanka
Marco Polo visits the coast of Ma’bar
Ulugh Khan annexes Madurai to the Delhi Sultanate

f.founder: Jatavarman Kulasekara I; Maravarman Sundara Pandya I
